# Crash The Stack hub tiles (ruling D60): the world drawn from small
# hand-defined bitmaps, 16x16 cells at scale 1, text-art like the font,
# the glyph sheets and the credits. Edit this file, not the module.
# scripts/art/hub-tiles turns it into src/crash/hub/tiles.sgl and
# assets/hub/tiles.png.
#
# A cell is . (transparent: the field shows through) or 1..8, an entry
# of the ramp below, eight palette roles from dark to bright with two
# accents (the teal wire for the runner and the data flow, the ICE
# orange for the ICE and the daemons' eyes). Palette roles only,
# dithered, no alpha (the style bible).
#
# A tile opens with "= name" and is followed by exactly sixteen rows of
# sixteen cells. The entities (the runner, the daemon) are drawn in the
# block alphabet's vocabulary: full blocks, glyphs first, icons later.

ramp: C-BG C-BAR-A C-BAR-C C-WIRE-DARK C-STATIC-B C-STATIC-A C-WIRE-LIT C-ICE
